KKA0250-TCPMM4.lead: Four long perforated channels that bake hot-dog buns to one even length.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Hot Dog Shaped 4 Slots Teflon Coated Perforated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 16.5x6x2.5cm) holds four elongated, round-ended slots side by side. Each slot is 16.5 cm long, 6 cm wide and 2.5 cm deep, and the whole tray measures about 34.5 × 21.5 cm.

Small holes run through the base and walls of every slot, letting hot air reach the underside of the dough instead of trapping it in a closed pan. Because liquid batter would drain through those holes, this one is meant for yeast dough. Cafés, snack counters and cloud kitchens serving hot dogs can bake their own buns rather than buying them in.
b: Slot Shape: Four elongated slots with rounded ends, each 16.5 × 6 cm and 2.5 cm deep.
Perforated Surface: Holes cover the floor and sides of each slot so heat and air pass through during baking.
Build: Teflon (non-stick) coated tray in a dark grey finish, about 34.5 × 21.5 cm and 424 g.
KKA0250-TCPMM4.suit: Hot-dog buns, long soft rolls and bun batches for cafés, snack counters, cloud kitchens and home bakers.
KKA0250-TCPMM4.care: Brush the slots with oil before each bake, let the tray cool fully before washing, and clear the holes with a soft brush rather than a metal scourer.
KKA0250-TCPMM4.title: Hot Dog Bun Mould 4 Slot Perforated Tray
KKA0250-TCPMM4.meta: Kitchenary Kart hot dog bun mould with 4 perforated, Teflon coated slots of 16.5 × 6 × 2.5 cm for baking even hot-dog rolls in cafés and home kitchens.

KKA0251-TCPMM1.lead: Four wide, shallow perforated slots for flat buns and mini pizza bases.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Pancake Shaped 4 Slots Teflon Coated Perforated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 12x2.5cm) sets four broad circular slots in a square tray of about 28 × 28 cm. Each is 12 cm across and 2.5 cm deep — flat and wide like a pancake rather than tall like a muffin cup.

Small holes pierce the base and walls, so hot air reaches the dough from underneath. Burger buns, small breads and mini pizzas appear in the product photos, making this a good match for burger joints, pizza outlets and bakeries that want four identical pieces per bake. Keep it for doughs; thin batter would run out through the perforations.
b: Slot Layout: Four circular slots in a 2 × 2 grid, 12 cm in diameter and 2.5 cm deep.
Perforations: Holes across the floor and sides let air and heat pass through while baking.
Coated Tray: Teflon (non-stick) coating, roughly 28 × 28 cm square and about 432 g.
KKA0251-TCPMM1.suit: Burger buns, flat breads, mini pizza bases and shallow bakes in quick-service kitchens, cafés and home bakeries.
KKA0251-TCPMM1.care: Oil or dust each slot before filling; once cool, wash gently with a sponge and never scrape the coated holes with a knife.
KKA0251-TCPMM1.title: Pancake Shaped 4 Slot Perforated Mould
KKA0251-TCPMM1.meta: Shallow 12 × 2.5 cm perforated rounds, four per tray, in a Teflon coated mould from Kitchenary Kart for burger buns, flat breads and mini pizza bases.

KKA0252-TCMM14.lead: A full dozen muffins or cupcakes from one tray.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Round 12 Big Slots Teflon Coated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 6.5x2.5cm) bakes twelve at a time in three rows of four. Each cup is 6.5 cm wide at the rim and 2.5 cm deep, set in a tray of about 35.5 × 26.5 cm.
A dozen per bake lines up with the way most bakery counters box and price their bakes. The cups take paper liners for cupcakes or can be greased and filled directly; the photos here show both.
b: Cup Count: 12 cups in a 3 × 4 layout.
Cup Size: 6.5 cm in diameter, 2.5 cm deep.
Build: Teflon (non-stick) coated tray, roughly 35.5 × 26.5 cm and about 250 g.
KKA0252-TCMM14.suit: Muffins, cupcakes, fairy cakes and dozen-box orders in bakeries, cafés, cake shops and home kitchens.
KKA0252-TCMM14.care: Grease or line the cups each time; after baking, allow the pan to cool, then wash by hand with a soft cloth and skip steel wool.
KKA0252-TCMM14.title: 12 Big Slot Round Muffin Mould 6.5cm
KKA0252-TCMM14.meta: Bake a dozen at once: Kitchenary Kart Teflon coated muffin tray with 12 round cups of 6.5 × 2.5 cm for muffins and cupcakes in bakeries and home kitchens.

KKA0253-TCMM13.lead: Twelve small, shallow cups for bite-size muffins and mini cupcakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Round 12 Small Slots Teflon Coated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 5x1.8cm) carries twelve compact hollows, each 5 cm across and 1.8 cm deep. The tray itself measures about 26 × 20.5 cm.

Shallow portions are handy for tasting boxes, party platters and mini-cupcake orders where customers want several flavours in one box. Mini paper cases can go in first, or each hollow can simply be greased.
b: Count: 12 round slots arranged 3 × 4.
Slot Size: 5 cm wide and 1.8 cm deep for bite-size portions.
Material: Teflon (non-stick) coating on a compact tray, around 26 × 20.5 cm and roughly 249 g.
KKA0253-TCMM13.suit: Mini muffins, bite-size cupcakes, small tea cakes and party platters for cake shops, cafés, caterers and home bakers.
KKA0253-TCMM13.care: Grease lightly or use mini paper cases; cool the tray before it goes into water, and avoid metal spatulas when lifting out the bites.
KKA0253-TCMM13.title: 12 Small Slot Round Muffin Mould 5cm
KKA0253-TCMM13.meta: Kitchenary Kart mini muffin mould: 12 shallow round cups of 5 × 1.8 cm on a Teflon coated tray for bite-size cupcakes, tasting boxes and party platters.

KKA0254-TCPMM3.lead: Twelve perforated cups for dinner rolls and slider buns.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Round 12 Small Slots Teflon Coated Perforated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 5.5x2cm) holds twelve round hollows, each 2 cm deep, in a tray of about 29 × 22 cm. Every one is pierced with tiny holes across its floor and walls.

Those holes let oven heat reach the underside of the dough instead of trapping it in a closed pan. Pictured on this page are a batch of little round rolls and a mini burger, so bakeries, burger outlets and cafés can bake their own sliders here. Use it for dough only, since batter would leak through.
b: Count: 12 perforated cups laid out 3 × 4.
Depth: 2 cm, with holes through the base and sides of every cup.
Tray: Non-stick (Teflon) coated, roughly 29 × 22 cm and about 400 g.
KKA0254-TCPMM3.suit: Dinner rolls, slider buns and small bread bakes for bakeries, burger outlets, cafés and home kitchens.
KKA0254-TCPMM3.care: Brush oil into each cup before use; wash only after the tray has cooled, using a soft brush to clear the holes and no abrasive pads.
KKA0254-TCPMM3.title: 12 Small Slot Perforated Muffin Mould
KKA0254-TCPMM3.meta: Twelve small perforated cups, 2 cm deep, on a Teflon coated tray from Kitchenary Kart for slider buns, dinner rolls and small bread bakes.
conflicts: Slot diameter: listing name, owner doc and listing dims say 5.5 cm; the dimension photo labels the cup 5 cm. Diameter not written anywhere except inside the product name.

KKA0255-TCMM15.lead: Two dozen muffins in a single bake.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Round 24 Big Slots Teflon Coated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 5x2cm) packs twenty-four round cups into four rows of six across a pan of about 37 × 25.5 cm. Each cup has a 5 cm diameter and a 2 cm depth.

Twenty-four per load cuts down the number of oven rounds for party orders, café display counters and wholesale batches. Product photos show golden muffins in the cups and a filled batch going into the oven.
b: Cup Count: 24 in a 4 × 6 grid.
Cup Size: 5 cm across and 2 cm deep.
Build: Teflon (non-stick) coated pan of around 37 × 25.5 cm; about 475 g.
KKA0255-TCMM15.suit: Mini muffins, cupcakes, small tea cakes and bulk party orders in bakeries, cafés, caterers and cloud kitchens.
KKA0255-TCMM15.care: Coat the cups with butter or oil, or drop in paper liners; leave the pan to cool, then hand-wash with mild soap and a non-scratch sponge.
KKA0255-TCMM15.title: 24 Slot Round Muffin Mould 5x2cm
KKA0255-TCMM15.meta: Kitchenary Kart 24-cup Teflon coated muffin mould, 5 × 2 cm cups on a 37 × 25.5 cm tray, for bulk muffins, cupcakes and party orders in one bake.

KKA0256-TCMM12.lead: Six roomy cups for small-batch muffins and cupcakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Round 6 Big Slots Teflon Coated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 6.5x2.5cm) is a compact tray of about 26 × 18 cm with six round hollows in two rows of three, each 6.5 cm wide at the rim.

Six at a time is a comfortable batch for home bakers, recipe trials and small cafés that bake fresh through the day. In the photos, the hollows are brushed with oil, filled with batter and turned out as chocolate cupcakes in paper cases.
b: Count: 6 round cups laid out 2 × 3.
Rim Width: 6.5 cm, wide enough for paper muffin cases as pictured.
Build: Non-stick coated tray, about 26 × 18 cm and 191 g.
KKA0256-TCMM12.suit: Muffins, cupcakes and small test batches for home bakers, home-based cake businesses and small cafés.
KKA0256-TCMM12.care: Brush each hollow with oil or butter first, let the tray cool completely after baking, and wash it with a soft sponge instead of a wire brush.
KKA0256-TCMM12.title: 6 Big Slot Round Muffin Mould 6.5cm
KKA0256-TCMM12.meta: Small-batch muffin tray by Kitchenary Kart: six 6.5 cm round cups on a 26 × 18 cm Teflon coated tray for home bakers, recipe trials and small cafés.

KKA0257-TCPMM2.lead: Nine large perforated cups for brioche and round bread rolls.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Round 9 Big Slots Teflon Coated Perforated Muffin Mould (Slot Size: 8x3cm) sets nine wide cups in a 3 × 3 square on a tray of about 32 × 30 cm. Each cup is 8 cm across and 3 cm deep, with holes punched through the base and sides.

The perforations let hot air move under and around the dough; the listing photos show glazed brioche buns and crackle-topped round rolls baked this way. Bakeries, burger kitchens and cafés can use it for large buns, keeping runny batters for a solid pan.
b: Cup Count: 9 round perforated cups in a 3 × 3 grid.
Cup Size: 8 cm in diameter with a 3 cm depth.
Coating and Size: Teflon non-stick finish, roughly 32 × 30 cm overall and about 562 g.
KKA0257-TCPMM2.suit: Brioche buns, burger buns, round bread rolls and yeast-dough bakes for bakeries, burger outlets, cafés and home bakers.
KKA0257-TCPMM2.care: Oil every cup before the dough goes in; wait for the tray to cool, then wash with a soft brush that reaches into the holes, never a scouring pad.

KKA0257-TCPMM2.meta: Kitchenary Kart perforated bun mould with nine 8 × 3 cm Teflon coated cups on a 32 × 30 cm tray for brioche, burger buns and round bread rolls.

KKA0258-TCMM1.lead: Forty half-sphere cavities for dome cakes and round-topped bites.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Round Semi Circle - 40 Slots sets forty hemispherical hollows in eight rows of five across a 60 × 40 cm sheet.
Portions come out with a smooth, curved top that needs little finishing. Pastry kitchens can bake small domed sponges here or set half-sphere chocolates; product photos show both.
b: Cavity Shape: 40 semi-circle domes, 6 cm wide at the rim and 2.5 cm deep, set 5 × 8.
Tray Size: 60 × 40 cm overall, so check that your oven deck or rack takes a sheet this large.
Coating: Teflon (non-stick) coated surface across the tray and every cavity.
KKA0258-TCMM1.suit: Dome cakes, half-sphere chocolates, round-topped tea cakes and large bakery batches.
KKA0258-TCMM1.care: Grease every dome before filling; once cool, wash with warm soapy water and a soft sponge, keeping knives and metal scrapers away from the coating.

KKA0258-TCMM1.meta: Kitchenary Kart 60 × 40 cm Teflon coated mould with 40 semi-circle domes, 6 cm wide, for dome cakes, half-sphere chocolates and big bakery batches.

KKA0259-TCMM2.lead: Thirty-five heart cavities for Valentine's Day bakes and love-themed orders.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Heart - 35 Slots lays out thirty-five heart-shaped hollows in five rows of seven on one 60 × 40 cm sheet.

Hearts are popular for Valentine's Day, anniversary and wedding orders, and one full load covers a large gift or party booking in a single bake. Photos on this page also show them filled with melted chocolate and a pink set dessert.
b: Cavity Shape: 35 hearts measuring roughly 6–6.5 cm wide with a 2.5 cm depth, in a 5 × 7 layout.
Tray Size: A large 60 × 40 cm bakery sheet.
Surface: Non-stick Teflon coating over the whole tray, cavities included.
KKA0259-TCMM2.suit: Heart cakes, Valentine's and anniversary bakes, chocolate hearts and gift-box fillers.
KKA0259-TCMM2.care: Butter or oil each shape before the batter goes in; wash only after the mould is cool, and use a soft cloth instead of scrubbers or metal tools.
KKA0259-TCMM2.title: Heart Muffin Mould 35 Slots Teflon Coated
KKA0259-TCMM2.meta: Heart-shaped Teflon coated muffin mould from Kitchenary Kart: 35 hearts of about 6.5 cm across a 60 × 40 cm sheet, made for Valentine's and gift orders.

KKA0260-TCMM3.lead: Thirty-two teddy-bear cavities that turn out cakes and sweets for children's parties.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Teddy Bear - 32 Slots has thirty-two bear-shaped cavities in four rows of eight across a 60 × 40 cm tray, with head, ears and arms moulded into each one.

Birthday parties, school events and return-gift boxes are where a bear shape earns its keep, and thirty-two per tray covers a class-size order in one go. Jelly sweets made in it appear in the listing photos as well.
b: Cavity Shape: 32 teddy bears, about 8 cm long and 2.5 cm deep, arranged 4 × 8.
Tray: 60 × 40 cm — measure your oven before ordering.
Finish: Teflon (non-stick) coating that helps the moulded detail come away cleanly.
KKA0260-TCMM3.suit: Teddy-bear cakes, kids' birthday treats, return-gift sweets and school-event orders.
KKA0260-TCMM3.care: Grease into the ears and arms before filling; after the tray cools, wash with a soft brush that reaches the small details, never a scouring pad.
KKA0260-TCMM3.title: Teddy Bear Muffin Mould 32 Slots
KKA0260-TCMM3.meta: Kitchenary Kart teddy bear mould: 32 bear cavities about 8 cm long in one Teflon coated 60 × 40 cm sheet, for kids' birthday cakes and return-gift sweets.

KKA0261-TCMM4.lead: Thirty-six oval cavities for finger cakes, filled bites and egg-shaped treats.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Oval - 36 Slots lines up thirty-six elongated hollows in four rows of nine on a 60 × 40 cm sheet.
The long shape works for small tea cakes, finger-style sponge portions and filled desserts. A chef piping filling into the cavities and chocolate eggs made in them appear in the product photos.
b: Cavity Shape: 36 ovals, roughly 8.5 cm long by 4.5 cm wide and 2.5 cm deep, laid out 4 × 9.
Overall Size: 60 × 40 cm tray.
Material: Teflon coated tray with a dark non-stick finish.
KKA0261-TCMM4.suit: Oval tea cakes, finger sponges, filled bakes, chocolate eggs and café dessert portions.
KKA0261-TCMM4.care: Brush each cavity with oil or butter before use; let the tray cool, then clean it by hand with mild detergent and no steel scrubbers.
KKA0261-TCMM4.title: Oval Muffin Mould 36 Slots Teflon Coated
KKA0261-TCMM4.meta: Oval Teflon coated muffin mould by Kitchenary Kart: 36 cavities of 8.5 × 4.5 cm in a 60 × 40 cm tray for finger cakes, filled desserts and chocolate eggs.

KKA0262-TCMM5.lead: Forty square cavities for brownie bites and neat, stackable portions.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Square - 40 Slots divides a 60 × 40 cm tray into forty straight-sided compartments, eight rows of five.

Flat-sided portions pack tightly in boxes and stack well on a display counter, which makes the shape handy for brownie bites, fudge and small tea cakes. Chocolate pieces topped with nuts appear in the listing photos.
b: Cavity Shape: 40 squares, each about 6 × 6 cm with 2.5 cm depth, in a 5 × 8 grid.
Tray Size: 60 × 40 cm overall — confirm your oven deck or rack has room for it.
Coating: Teflon (non-stick) coated surface across the tray and each compartment.
KKA0262-TCMM5.suit: Brownie bites, fudge and chocolate squares, square tea cakes and boxed dessert orders.
KKA0262-TCMM5.care: Line or grease each compartment; allow the tray to cool before soaking, and lift portions out with a silicone or wooden tool rather than a metal knife.

KKA0262-TCMM5.meta: Kitchenary Kart square muffin mould: 40 compartments of 6 × 6 cm in a Teflon coated 60 × 40 cm tray for brownie bites, fudge squares and boxed desserts.

KKA0263-TCMM6.lead: Forty flower cavities for petal-shaped tea cakes and festive platters.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Flower - 40 Slots carries forty rounded-petal hollows in eight rows of five on a 60 × 40 cm sheet.
Petal outlines dress up a platter without extra decorating work, so they fit festival hampers, baby showers and high-tea menus. In the photos, a poured jelly is setting in the cavities.
b: Cavity Shape: 40 flowers with rounded petals, roughly 6 cm wide and 2.5 cm deep, set 5 × 8.
Tray Size: 60 × 40 cm, a full-size bakery sheet.
Surface: Non-stick Teflon coating over the entire tray, petals included.
KKA0263-TCMM6.suit: Flower tea cakes, festival and baby-shower platters, jellies and high-tea menus.
KKA0263-TCMM6.care: Oil the petals well before filling; wash the cooled mould with a soft sponge and keep sharp or metal tools off the coated surface.

KKA0263-TCMM6.meta: Forty petal-shaped cavities, about 6 cm each, fill this Kitchenary Kart Teflon coated flower mould, sized 60 × 40 cm, for tea cakes, platters and jellies.

KKA0264-TCMM7.lead: Thirty-five fluted flower cavities for ridged mini cakes.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Flower - 35 Slots has thirty-five flower cavities, arranged five across and seven down in the main listing photos. Grooved walls give each piece a scalloped, bundt-style outline.

Scalloped sponges look finished straight out of the mould, saving icing time for cafés, tea rooms and bakeries selling plain bakes. Batter being poured in and golden turned-out pieces are shown on this page.
b: Cavity Shape: 35 fluted flowers with ridged sides, in a 5 × 7 layout.
Batch Size: Thirty-five small cakes from one fill.

KKA0264-TCMM7.care: Grease right into every groove with a pastry brush; clean the cooled tray with a soft bristle brush and mild soap, never wire wool.

KKA0266-TCMM9.meta: High-volume Kitchenary Kart muffin mould with 54 round 5 cm cavities over a 60 × 40 cm non-stick sheet, built for catering, event orders and mini cupcakes.

p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Round - 40 Slots holds forty circular cavities in eight rows of five across a 60 × 40 cm tray.

KKA0267-TCMM10.meta: Forty 6 cm round cavities on one 60 × 40 cm Teflon coated tray: a Kitchenary Kart muffin mould for cupcakes, tea cakes and daily bakery batches.

KKA0268-TCMM11.lead: Twenty-four wide round cavities for full-size muffins.
p: The Kitchenary Kart Teflon Coated Muffin Mould — Round - 24 Slots gives twenty-four wide hollows in six rows of four on a 60 × 40 cm tray.
